Direct last-session Delete calls finish_seal_locked at 257-260; that function marks the host Pending at 298 while provider destruction is running, and records Failed on an error at 299-303. The finisher can snapshot that Pending host while its direct Delete still holds the provisioning lock. If an earlier host in the snapshot takes time, the direct Delete can finish with Failed before the finisher reaches this host. finish_seal at 281-287 only checks whether the provisioning lock is available, without rechecking that the host is still Pending. It then calls sealed_attempt, which overwrites Failed with Pending (manager.rs:2628-2633), and performs another provider destruction. sealed_pending filters failures only at snapshot creation (manager.rs:2709-2718); note_sealed retaining a Failed value at 2610-2619 does not prevent this stale-snapshot path. hosts.rs:1537-1545 returns provider failures while retaining the host and releasing its connection hold, so the needed failed direct attempt is a shipped path. Fix direction: after taking the provisioning lock, atomically recheck/claim Pending for an automatic finisher attempt, separately from explicit Retry/direct Delete, and skip Failed or removed records. Suggested bucket: other (retry-policy and diagnostic correctness; no established material additional harm).
